I dig and I dig

He's coming?

Be careful and don't be fooled by his

Roger!

I figured we'd run into him sooner or later if we waited here!
Slow ahead!
Slow ahead!

Blow him and his little toy boat out of the water!

Who cares!? Once he's out of the way,
we can get whatever we want from the mayor, right!?
We've got to take care of him once and for all...
Thanks to him, our plans have been completely ruined!

What's wrong with me?
Why should I care if he... if that little brat dies--I shouldn't!
I really shouldn't...
Someone's been taking really good care of this boat!
There!
Do you really think you should be doing that?
Would you look at this engine? Let's see...
All we need to do is fix the transformer and
the refractor and it'll be as good as new!
What do you think you're you doing?

text: MegaMan? Could you hand me a wrench?

text: There we go, all fixed! Whoops! I'm sorry...
I don't know what came over me... I just started fixing the ship and...

Roll, your face! It's covered with grease!
I'm glad I could get someone as pretty as you to fix my boat for me!
Tell you what! You can use it anytime you want!
We'll be able to get to the island now!
That's great! Let me know when you want to go out to the island!
I'll pilot the boat for you! See ya later!

We'll go back to the ship, and come up with a new plan!
Yeah...

Now, I couldn't have asked for a better brother and sister than you!
We'll get that blue boy next time for sure!
I don't understand...
Even though he got the better of us again, I don't feel the least bit angry...
What is that?

text: OK, I'm fresh out of ideas.
You know, what bothers me most is that while we're sitting here,
he's out there, digging up all sorts of stuff!

no one will as long as that big door is still locked!

We'll wait for him to open the Main Gate--we'll
let him keep whatever he finds until then!
He'll see--it'll be the Bonnes who'll have the last laugh in this game!

text: That's right!
You did it, boss!
MegaMan!

Thank you for awakening me...

You... you know me?
You don't remember?

carbons that have overpropagated during the time I was inactive.

the number of carbon units is not allowed

if this happens, they are to be purged immediately.

Carbons? Do you mean... The people on the island!

Reinitialize? I haven't understood much of what you have been saying,
but when you say "reinitialize", do you mean... NO!
Huh!
This is quite depreciable.

such as yourself. Once my task is complete,

Until then...

Up and away!
